mods.name: Frozen Registry Fix
mods.description: Keeps Immersive Armors' lazily registered armor materials compatible with NeoForge's frozen registry lifecycle. It force-initializes the target before a writable freeze when possible and narrowly permits only immersive_armors armor-material keys when NeoForge has already frozen that registry.

mods.name: Frozen Registry Fix
mods.description: Force-initializes mods that register registry content in a lazily-loaded static initializer (e.g. Immersive Armors' Items class) before the registries freeze, fixing 'Registry is already frozen' crashes in large packs. v2.1.0 hooks BOTH GameData.freezeData() HEAD and the low-level MappedRegistry.freeze() of the armor_material registry, so the force-init fires even when load-order disruptors (e.g. railways-untold / Create coremods) reroute the freeze around GameData.freezeData.
